title: The Best Lamb Chops
description: Lamb chops seasoned with garlic and rosemary are roasted in the oven and always turn out flavorsome, perfectly juicy, and tender in under 30 minutes.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).

Cut away excess fat from lamb chops (some fat does add flavor). Coat each chop lightly in olive oil. Season lamb chops with garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Place lamb chops in a cast iron skillet.

Bake uncovered in the preheated oven until cooked through, 8 to 10 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 140 degrees F (60 degrees C) for medium-well doneness.
Remove from the oven and cover tightly with foil; let rest for 8 to 10 minutes. Serve with mint jelly on the side.

video.description: Prepare this recipe, and you’ll experience the exquisite flavors of succulent Greek-inspired lamb chops! In this video, watch how to make “The Best Lamb Chops,” a mouthwatering recipe passed down by a 100% Greek mother-in-law. With a perfect blend of garlic and rosemary, these chops are oven-baked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet. Impress your guests with minimal effort – coat the chops in olive oil, sprinkle with garlic and rosemary, and let the oven work its magic. A delectable treat served with mint jelly on the side. Try this culinary delight today!
